+import re
+
+from translation_client import get_translation_client, translate_with_client
+from translation_models import normalize_payload
+
+
+TAG_RE = re.compile(r"(<[^>]+>|[^<]+)")
+
+
+def translate_markup(payload, config=None):
+    payload = normalize_payload(payload)
+    client = get_translation_client(config)
+    parts = []
+    for chunk in TAG_RE.findall(payload["markup"]):
+        if chunk.startswith("<") and chunk.endswith(">"):
+            parts.append(chunk)
+        else:
+            parts.append(
+                translate_with_client(client, chunk, payload["source_language"], payload["target_language"])
+            )
+    return {
+        "markup": "".join(parts),
+        "source_language": payload["source_language"],
+        "target_language": payload["target_language"],
+    }
+
*** End Patch

+import boto3
+

+def unsafe_copy_check(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("comprehend", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    response = client.detect_sentiment(Text=payload["text"], LanguageCode=payload["language"])
+    return {
+        "text": payload["text"],
+        "language": payload["language"],
+        "sentiment": response.get("Sentiment"),
+        "scores": response.get("SentimentScore", {}),
+    }
+

*** Add File: translation_memory_embedding.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def translation_memory_embedding(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    body = {"inputText": payload["text"]}
+    response = client.invoke_model(
+        modelId="amazon.titan-embed-text-v1",
+        body=str(body).replace("'", '"').encode("utf-8"),
+        contentType="application/json",
+        accept="application/json",
+    )
+    return {
+        "text": payload["text"],
+        "embedding": response["body"].read(),
+    }
+
*** End Patch

+import boto3
+
+
+def localized_audio_preview(payload, config=None):

+    client = boto3.client("polly", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    response = client.synthesize_speech(
+        Text=payload["text"],
+        OutputFormat="mp3",
+        VoiceId=payload.get("voice_id", "Joanna"),
+        Engine="neural",

+    return {
+        "text": payload["text"],
+        "audio_stream": response["AudioStream"].read(),
+    }
